D.expected_no_scripts: Documentary extraction only, no statistical pipeline or microdata; no invent code SHA.

A: Test whether a completely different original randomized human study manipulates no/private/public relative GOAL rank and reports differential effort, goal ambition or net productivity, and whether public-v-private difference can be claimed when treatments otherwise differ. Unit published treatment cell/estimand, not human row.

B.H1: Original randomized no/private/public goal rank design provides a valid within-study comparison of publicity while holding common task and monetary goal-contingent incentives, but directional effects on realized productivity/goal achievement may differ from ambition.
B.H0: Public/private treatments differ in more than publicness, estimates are not reported or statistically supported; no clean usable contrast.
other: Goal rank, rank of achieved performance and own reward are distinct treatments; never pretend goal ranking validates PFL performance leaderboard.
Any reported results are study-specific and may be selection-contaminated or not preregistered.

C.primary_source: Yan, Jing & Li (2026), Aiming High, Falling Short: Experimental Evidence on How Goal Rank Feedback Affects Goal-Setting and Productivity, SSRN abstract ID 6006394, PDF supplied by SSRN, public draft revised Apr 30 2026
C.pre_freeze_seen: Search result/title, date and summary paragraph already reveal NONE/PRIVATE/PUBLIC treatment names and promise relation between ambition/productivity; outcomes NOT independently inspected beyond suggestive title and snippet. No blind confirmatory efficacy claim.
C.planned_read: Inspect original study paper methods/tables via PDF and screenshot before citing. Extract treatment arm definition, N per arm, how reward is held constant, pre/post and publicness contrasts, productivity and goal selection outcomes with significance/uncertainty, randomization, exclusions/attrition and source rights. No participant rows downloaded.
C.falsifier: Missing true public/private isolation or effects only in self-reported goals, not productivity, or no primary numerical evidence: classify inconclusive or prior art only.
C.competent_baseline: C12 AAAI private score quartile RCT and C14 synthetic private/public x granularity; 2026 goals rank is different treatment content.

E: Read original PDF after GitHub prereg commit. If PDF inaccessible, original method cannot be verified; stop without consuming cycle. Record quotation limits and screenshot pages, cite primary.
F: Inspect opposite directions and confidence intervals; do not treat non-significant as zero, do not borrow reported difference to PFL, do not infer actual effect without source.
G: Same paper private vs public within randomized study, plus NONE; qualify whether outcome is goals vs performance and reward parity. No differential exposure on PFL users.
H: Update PF-BR72 only if original independent substantive methodology/outcome is verified and source rights acceptable; not generic paper repetition.
I: CT2 PFL remains 20/100 unless separately strong transportability and independent PFL empirical evidence; N1–3=0, launch 0/6; external study original does not create new PFL causal validation.
J: If actual original document inspected and useful contrast/negative classified, one limited AB-R C32; 8 remain. If absent or merely repetitive, do NOT count. No downloads of raw people, contact, license acceptance.
